purpose: Microscopic tissue atlas for Profile B (primarily B1 skin). General skin/melanoma anatomy is CONTEXTUAL_ANATOMY scaffolding cited to open atlases; it is NOT the B1 experimental specimen. Quantitative specifics are cited or marked qualitative/NOT_REPORTED. No invented structures/dimensions.

species_differences: Transdermal Permeation of Drugs in Various Animal Species, Pharmaceutics 2017;9(3):33, PMC5620574
Allometric scaling of skin thickness, PMC5698453

layers.confidence: CONTEXTUAL_ANATOMY (structure) + DIRECTLY_OBSERVED (B1 depth deposition 0-30 um band)
layers.structure: flattened ANUCLEATE corneocytes in a 'bricks-and-mortar' arrangement with extracellular lipid lamellae (mortar)
layers.visual_rule: no nuclei in the SC; show corneocyte stacks + lipid lamellae as the primary barrier; nanoparticle deposition and released-API diffusion shown here
layers.do_not: show living nucleated cells or blood vessels in the SC; assign a specific SC thickness for the B1 rat specimen (NOT REPORTED in package)

layers.structure: keratinized stratified squamous epithelium; nucleated keratinocytes; melanocytes at the basale; Langerhans cells (immune) in spinosum
layers.visual_rule: EPIDERMIS IS AVASCULAR - never draw blood vessels inside it. Basale can carry melanocytes (dendritic, basal). Simplified 2-3 band grouping acceptable if labelled.
layers.b1_link: 30-60 um depth band (approx; species-dependent) - label as approximate, not exact for the specimen
layers.do_not: vessels in epidermis; exact per-layer thickness for the B1 specimen

layers.structure: dense irregular connective tissue: collagen bundles, elastin, ground substance (GAGs/hyaluronan); fibroblasts; capillary loops (papillary) + deeper plexus (reticular); appendages (hair follicles, sweat/sebaceous glands); immune cells
layers.visual_rule: vessels appear HERE as anatomical context; denser ECM than epidermis; appendages optional/context-only
layers.b1_link: 60-90 um depth band (approx); deeper deposition context
layers.do_not: imply nanoparticle entry into dermal vessels -> systemic circulation (UNSUPPORTED for B1)

layers.visual_rule: orientation-only or omit; B1 supported depth (<=~90 um sections) does NOT reach hypodermis
layers.do_not: show nanoparticles reaching subcutaneous tissue (no evidence)

melanoma_tissue.confidence: CONTEXTUAL_ANATOMY for human histopathology; B1 model is MURINE B16BL6 (culture + subcutaneous mouse) - NOT human invasive cutaneous melanoma
melanoma_tissue.human_histopathology_features: nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, loosely cohesive cells, nests + single cells, dermal invasion with loss of maturation, atypia retained with depth (DermNet/Libre/Modern Pathology)
melanoma_tissue.b1_melanoma_representation: murine B16BL6 tumour context (pigmented mouse melanoma); label as murine model; do NOT depict human clinical invasive melanoma as the B1 result
melanoma_tissue.do_not: portray advanced invasive human melanoma histology as the B1 experimental outcome

species_compatibility_note: rodent (rat/mouse) viable epidermis ~20 um, thinner SC, higher hair-follicle density (rat ~1.84%, mouse ~2.02%) than human; rat skin typically OVER-predicts human permeation (PMC5620574). Every skin scene must state which species/model it represents. Rat permeation data must NOT be shown as human skin behavior without an explicit transfer label.

scale_bands_B1.note: bands are the Chen section boundaries; do NOT assign a continuous concentration field
